title: Sensei Provider Port Execution Receipt V1
description: The O2 provider execution receipt: binds request, capability snapshot, provider identity, result, observations, and terminal outcome into one inspectable record. O2 recomputes and verifies this receipt's own digest and every digest it references; a provider-declared digest is never trusted unchecked.
$comment: Canonical producer/owner: globulario/sensei, golang/architecture/providerport. result_digest_sha256 is ALWAYS required, on every terminal_outcome including a typed failure -- a Result envelope is always produced as evidence, so a receipt must always be able to point to it; losing that pointer on failure would silently drop the Result's evidence. payload_digest_sha256 is the separate, optional digest naming the candidate payload specifically (mirrors Result's own payload_digest_sha256): non-null exactly when terminal_outcome is completed. observation_batch_digest_sha256 is independently nullable -- a batch may or may not exist regardless of outcome.

result_digest_sha256.$comment: Always required -- references the Result envelope produced for this request, whether it completed or failed.

started_at.$comment: Observation timestamp, explicitly excluded from receipt_digest_sha256 so receipt identity does not depend on wall-clock time.

receipt_digest_sha256.$comment: Self-referential semantic digest of this document with this field zeroed before hashing.
